events.summary: Here's all the changes for the demo this week. This update shouldn't break anyone's saves. events.title: Echoes of Aromia Demo - Content update patch notes
events.summary: I hope everyone's having a good weekend! Here's all the changes for the demo this week. This update shouldn't break anyone's saves. But just to be cautious i recommend anyone who is interested in trying out the new content to start a new save. Major changes: - Added a new way to start the raider quest ''THOSEWHOSATDOWN''. events.title: Echoes of Aromia - Demo out now!
events.summary: We're proud to announce the release of the demo for Echoes of Aromia! I want to say a huge thanks for everyone who has supported us, all the artists, volunteers, playtesters, everyone has donated their time, and helped put their heart and soul into this project, it would not be here without your help. I hope you all enjoy the demo, it has been the culmination of a year of work. Thank you.

events.title: Echoes of Aromia Playtest is now live!
events.summary: Hey everyone! First time sending out one of these community announcements through steam.I just wanted to say, the playtest page has just been approved and is now live! So if you've been meaning to try out the game, and playtest, and help me shape the game, now is your chance!All you gotta do is head over to the steam page, and click that ''Join the Playtest'' Button!I'm excited to hear all your feedback, You can send any feedback into the community hub, or reach out directly at Nighttarga@gmail.
